requirements.quote:
All of the security considerations that apply to TLS also apply to
   the use of TLS in QUIC.
requirements.required_behavior: Apply the security considerations applicable to TLS.
requirements.why_checkable: The statement incorporates an unenumerated set of considerations from all of TLS 1.3 and its appendices; this chunk provides no atomic behavior, condition, or expected result for an implementation test.
